correctness.rationale: The exact source inequalities give \(|a_\alpha u^\alpha|\le (m^m/\alpha^\alpha)^{1/p-1/t}\|P\|_p\) after normalizing \(\|u\|_t=1\). When \(u^\alpha\neq0\), the exponent support has at most \(k=\min\{s,m\}\) points. For \(p<t\), minimizing \(\alpha^\alpha\) over positive integer compositions is exact: splitting forces \(k\) parts and convex smoothing forces entries \(q\) and \(q+1\). The corresponding monomial and norming vector attain equality. For \(t\le p\), the exponent is nonpositive and the pure power attains the constant \(1\). All quantifiers and endpoint conventions are covered.
